metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1987 · Where Is the Friend's House?
metas.description: Eight-year-old Ahmed has mistakenly taken his friend Mohammad's notebook. He wants to return it, or else his friend will be expelled from school. The boy determinedly sets out to find Mohammad's home in the neighbouring village.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1976 · The Twelve Tasks of Asterix
metas.description: Asterix and Obelix are tasked by Julius Caesar with accomplishing twelve impossible labors to determine the fate of their indomitable Gaulish village.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 1973 · Ivan Vasilyevich Changes His Profession
metas.description: An ordinary Soviet building manager, living in the 20th century, looks like Tsar of All Rus' - Ivan IV the Terrible (1530 - 1584). He'd never known this, until his neighbor created a time machine.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1978 · The 36th Chamber of Shaolin
metas.description: A school student who conspires with his teacher and others to overthrow the Qing Dynasty sees his family slaughtered at the hands of his enemies. He joins the Shaolin Temple and rigorously studies martial arts to avenge his belove...

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1988 · The Bear
metas.description: An orphan bear cub hooks up with an adult male as they try to dodge human hunters.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1970 · Santa Claus Is Comin' to Town
metas.description: A mailman reveals the origin of Santa Claus.

metas.name: ★ 8.7 · 1980 · Who's Singin' Over There?
metas.description: It's April 5, 1941, somewhere in Serbia. A group of people go on a bus to Belgrade, on a journey that will change their lives forever.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1984 · Sexmission
metas.description: Two scientists are placed into a 3-year hibernation, but when they wake up, it turns out to have been 50 years, and they are the only two males in a new underground society composed exclusively of women.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 1986 · Cat City
metas.description: An agent delivers plans to save mice from a feline syndicate dedicated to eradicating rodents.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1982 · The Plague Dogs
metas.description: Two dogs escape from a laboratory and are hunted as possible carriers of the bubonic plague.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1972 · Lone Wolf and Cub: Sword of Vengeance
metas.description: The story of a Ronin (i.e. a masterless samurai) who wanders the countryside of Japan with his small child, having various adventures.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1983 · Never Cry Wolf
metas.description: A government researcher, sent to research the "menace" of wolves in the north, learns about the true beneficial and positive nature of the species.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1971 · A Touch of Zen
metas.description: A lady fugitive on the run from corrupt government officials is joined in her endeavors by an unambitious painter and skilled Buddhist monks.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1971 · Twelve Chairs
metas.description: Two gentlemen of fortune from the times of Imperial Russia are looking for an uncountable treasure at the dawn of the Soviet Union age.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1974 · Swept Away
metas.description: A trip into the Mediterranean sea becomes a trip into the discovery of how society's frameworks of the rich and poor are delicate and temporary.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 1972 · Lone Wolf and Cub: Baby Cart at the River Styx
metas.description: Trailed by a clan of female ninja, Ogami is paid to assassinate a clan traitor accompanied by three killers known as the Gods of Death.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1974 · Unbelievable Adventures of Italians in Russia
metas.description: The mad adventures of the mad Italians, searching for the mad treasures in the mad Russia.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 1981 · The Little Fox
metas.description: Famous, great hunters, better stay away, here comes Vuk! (They say he is cunning as a fox!)

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1983 · El Norte
metas.description: After their family is killed in a government massacre, siblings Enrique and Rosa flee Guatemala and embark on a perilous journey to "El Norte": the United States.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 1980 · Shogun
metas.description: An English navigator becomes both pawn and player in the deadly political games in feudal Japan.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1989 · Treasure Island. Captain Flint's Map
metas.description: Cartoon adaptation of Robert Louis Stevenson's most famous adventure novel.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 1987 · Sherlock Holmes: The Sign of Four
metas.description: The disappearance of a young woman's father and a mysterious note years later after the strange regular annual delivery of valuable pearls to her puts Sherlock Holmes on the case.
